kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Dependence on cyclical markets (aerospace, transportation)
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in risk factors, the language is strong (materially harm). This risk is structural and impacts a significant portion of revenues. 70% of revenues come from aerospace markets.

risks.title: Volatility in raw material and energy prices
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with examples (nickel, titanium) and causes (Russia-Ukraine conflict, inflation). The impact on costs is emphasized (materially adversely affected).

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions and supplier dependency
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described with reliance on sole or limited suppliers and potential consequences (materially adverse effect). Causes are multiple (geopolitical, quality, cyberattacks).

risks.title: Manufacturing operations risks and interruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well detailed, covering equipment failures, natural disasters, quality issues, and consequences on reputation and contracts.

risks.title: Dependence on key customers and their financial health
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highlighted with the example of Boeing and its impact on production. The loss or deterioration of a key customer's condition is deemed critical (materially affect).

risks.title: Cyberattacks and information systems security
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described as a growing threat with potentially severe consequences on intellectual property, operations, and reputation (material adverse effect).

risks.title: Difficulty attracting and retaining skilled workforce
risks.score_rationale: This risk is considered important for growth, especially in aerospace. Skill shortages and rising labor costs are explicitly mentioned.

ai_positioning.summary: The company HWM does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report.
